before: Legacy checkbox form fields could not be toggled, picture and building block gallery controls had no widget, and content-control value pop-ups were engine-only.
after: New setLegacyCheckbox and insertBuildingBlock ops rewrite w:checked and a gallery control’s w:sdtContent, picture controls replace their image through the existing replaceDrawingResource op, and pop-ups and widgets are host-composable; shared document state keeps the same OOXML shape.
reason: Both new ops reduce to existing canonical tree primitives (a node replacement under the field’s w:checkBox or the control’s w:sdtContent), which the journal already replicates, so released participants read the resulting state unchanged. Pop-up and widget changes are local chrome and never enter shared updates.
